page.title: Object-oriented programming
page.desc: Bundling state with the operations on it: objects, classes or prototypes, encapsulation and polymorphism. Simula 67 introduced classes; Alan Kay's Smalltalk coined the term.
page.intro: Bundling state with the operations on it: objects, classes or prototypes, encapsulation and polymorphism. Simula 67 introduced classes; Alan Kay's Smalltalk coined the term.

synapses.text: Simula 67 had classes and inheritance; Smalltalk (1970s) made everything an object and message passing the core idea.
Kay later said the big idea was messaging and late binding, not classes and inheritance.
Code written against an interface works with any implementation; the Liskov substitution principle says when that is safe.

children.title: SOLID principles
children.desc: Five design principles popularised by Robert C. Martin: single responsibility, open/closed, Liskov substitution, interface segregation, dependency inversion.

children.title: Composition over inheritance
children.desc: Prefer building behaviour from small components to deep class hierarchies; a core recommendation of the 1994 Design Patterns book.
